Why work at Auctor

Unchartered territory

You won't be optimizing an existing product in a saturated market. Systems integration is a massive white space. You’ll be joining a team building a new category with no existing leader and meaningful upside if we get this right.

Outsized impact

We’re a quickly growing team, backed by Sequoia, Microsoft, HubSpot, Workday, OneStream, and Y Combinator. Every person at this stage shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory.

Real-world deployment

Auctor is a ubiquitous product. Our deployments team work directly with customers to drive adoption and configure workflows to match how teams work.

Values we live by

Respect. Attention to Detail. Creative. Bias Towards Action. These aren’t poster values. They guide who we bring onto the team and how we make decisions across the company.

Benefits to support your best work

Auctor offers a comprehensive benefits program through our Professional Employer Organization (PEO) to support the health and well being of employees and their families. Eligible employees may enroll in:

  • Medical insurance

  • Dental insurance

  • Vision insurance

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) if enrolled in an eligible health plan

  • Optional supplemental coverage including accident, hospital, and critical illness insurance

All full time employees receive a semi monthly gym membership stipend to support health and fitness.

Lunch and dinner are provided on workdays at the office to support collaboration and allow the team to remain focused and onsite during the workday.

Uber rides may be provided when employees are required to work unusually late due to business needs. This is intended to support employee safety.

Auctor offers unlimited PTO to support flexibility and well being. Employees may take reasonable time off for vacation, personal matters, or rest, while coordinating with their manager to ensure responsibilities are covered and team needs are met. PTO is not accrued and therefore unused time is not carried over or paid out upon separation.
